about: (Noah, 2026-11-21: 'give each class voice lines for their class chosen' - male + female per class, rounds and story triggers; 20 per class to test) each line's id; its words (as in the Class Voices and Story Roles doc, 2026-11-23; shown as its subtitle). Files: assets/sound/classvo/<id>_male.wav, <id>_female.wav (from Noah's mp3s).

rows.text: The dead are waking. Good. So are mine.
Hush now... get ready.
Another night. Come, spirits. Stand with me.
Dawn. Rest now, all of you. Even the ones I didn't call.
The sun takes them back. Until tonight.
Quiet again. I can hear the dead complaining.
A Dragon Priest... his mask still hums with the old words.
That one has been dead longer than this land has had a name.
A dragon. Its soul is louder than all the rest.
Alduin calls, and his kin answer. So will mine.
Something is wrong with tonight. The spirits won't come near it.
The veil is thin tonight. Stay close to me.
The curse let go of this place. The dead can sleep here again.
Listen... No screaming under the stones... Just wind.
So many restless souls in these streets.
This city still belongs to the dead. Not for long.
The bones remember. Keep going.
Something old just turned to look at us.
Do you feel them? Waiting under every footstep.
Even the silence has a voice, if you're patient enough to hear it.
Here they come. Let's light this place up.
Fire, frost or lightning. Pick how you'd like to die.
Night falls. My hands are already burning.
Dawn. And not a single one left standing. Shame.
Smell that? Ash and morning. My favourite.
Survived another one. Barely broke a sweat.
A Dragon Priest. Let's see how well that mask handles a firestorm.
Big, old and angry. Burns the same as the rest.
Dragon! Finally, something worth the magicka.
You breathe fire? Cute. Watch this.
Tonight's different. Good. I was getting bored.
Something's off. Stay behind me. Way behind me.
City's free. Tell the bards I did most of it.
Curse broken. Someone owes me a drink. Several.
This place reeks of the curse. Time to clean it out.
Another city under Alduin's boot. Not for long.
Ha! That did something. Do it again.
Old magic. Strong, too. I like it.
Nothing to burn. I hate waiting.
Come on, night. I've got spells going stale here.
Right. Flasks full, corks loose. Let's begin.
The dead rise on schedule. Shame nothing else in Skyrim does.
Tonight's experiment: how many of you fit in one fireball.
Dawn. Write it down: subjects, unresponsive. Very unresponsive.
Morning. Time to scrape them off my boots and restock.
Made it. Mostly in one piece. Mostly.
A Dragon Priest. I'd love a sample of whatever keeps him going.
Big one. Good thing I brought the strong stuff.
A dragon! Do you know what its blood would fetch?
Scales, bone, heartblood... hold still, you beautiful thing.
Something in the air tonight. Don't breathe it. Trust me.
Odd night. My flasks are bubbling on their own.
There. The rot's gone out of this place. My work here is done.
City cured. If only every illness were this satisfying.
Smell that? The curse is in the water here.
Sick city. Let's see what the cure looks like.
Interesting. Very interesting.
That reaction shouldn't be possible. Let's do it again.
I'll just reorganise my flasks again. Third time today.
Nirnroot, deathbell, a pinch of patience... still waiting.
They're coming. Blade up. Spell ready.
Hold the line. Nothing gets past us.
Night again. Same as before: steel first, then fire.
Dawn. Clean your blade. Count your wounds.
We held. That's all that matters.
Another night survived. They won't remember us. Good.
Dragon Priest. Watch his hands, not his mask.
That one's the real fight. Stay sharp.
Dragon. Get under its wings and don't stop moving.
It bleeds. Then it can die.
Something's changed tonight. Eyes open.
Different enemy, same answer.
City's ours. The people can sleep tonight.
The curse breaks here. One less to carry.
Curse is thick here. Weapons drawn.
These people need a sword, not a speech.
That's a sign. We follow it.
Old magic answers. Keep moving.
Waiting is part of the work.
Rest while you can. The night doesn't wait.
